text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days after Bamboo Memory's debut raceâ

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Good morniiing!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on the Way to School
text_block_list.text: Good morning~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —Ah, Bamboo-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Good morning!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Chiyono O! That's just what I'd expect
from a Disciplinary Committee Award winner!
What a refreshing greeting!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Sakura Chiyono O. Serious, bright, and a truly exemplary Umamusume...!
As her classmate, I have to learn from her example!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you very much.
Ever since my debut race ended,
I've been feeling super motivated!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I want to do my best for the races ahead...
So, I want our daily greetings to be great too!
After all, "A good greeting beats a good carrot!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's a fantastic mindset!!
Gaaah! I can't let myself fall behind either!!
I'm gonna put my all into today toooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (VRRRROOOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew~♪ What a super groovy morning!
On a day like this, I just gotta
ride Tacchan to school!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Bamboo-chan, Chiyo-chan, ciao~♪

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Maruzen-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, good morning!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You both seem even more fired up
since making your debuts!
I can really feel your motivation bursting today♪

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
We were just talking about hyping each other up!
We're fully powered up and raring to go!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—Maruzen-san! I... well, um...
I'm going to try even, even harder from now on!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Aiming for the Japan Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu.
Do your best, Chiyo-chan.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Your big sister will always, always...
be cheering you on.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—You too, Bamboo-chan!
I'm counting on you to give it everything you've got and be totally grooovy♪

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: THANK YOU SO MUUUCH!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, see ya later♪
Byee-bee~♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Maruzen-san was so wonderful
today as well... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O really does look up to Maruzen-senpai, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
She's the senior I look up to, and—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Someday, without fail, I want to catch up to her...
I want to run alongside her...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That is my "dream"!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —So hot!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"That's one heck of an inspiring dream!!
So for Chiyono O, Maruzen-senpai is
both an idol and a future rival, right!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
R-R-Rival?! No way!
Th-That's way too huge an honor!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If... if I could really become that...
If I actually could...—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...No, no, no! What are you doing?!
We have things to do before that!
As they say, 'Stare too long at a high mountain, and you'll lose your way!'"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to support Chiyono O's "dream"
with everything I've got!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I really wanna see you competing with
Maruzen-senpai at full power, Chiyono O!
I just know you can make it happen, Chiyono O!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Bamboo-san—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you so much.
That gave me a little bit of courage.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You too, Bamboo-san...
Please do your best towards your "dream"!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sir!!
Let's both fire ourselves up!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—And that was the burning "dream"
Chiyono O had!!
I just thought it was so insanely cool!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Whenever Yaeno or Chiyono O talks about their "dream," they shine so dazzlingly...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I wanna be just like those two...!
I can't afford to fall behind!
choice_data_list: Alright then, let's get fired up and go again today!
Alright then, let's give it our all again today!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sir!!
I'm gettin' super-duper fired upーー!!!
